lead.what: Dawn puts U.S.–Iran talks on this week's calendar after the seven-day reopen roadmap fell; the Korean capture has no date. Graves's 0.52 call is the day's forecast.

rest.what: Vučić resigned the presidency Sunday before the term ended, recorded as a bid for the premiership on 25 October.
